formats.summary: No stamp: archiveMode is the bare value "Plaintext" or "Encrypted". The shapes these two releases persist were never snapshotted, and they differ from each other.

formats.writtenBy: PathKeep 0.6.0, in development: every archive it creates, every archive of 0.4 or 0.5 it opens, and every archive a restore, an import or a conversion installs.
formats.summary: archiveMode becomes the stamped object, and the archive holds two more stores: the agent-history evidence (archive/agent-history.db) and its read model (derived/agent-history-read-model.db). Device capture policy defaults to browsing on and conversations off on older controls. The optional captureInstallation field binds capture choices and hints to the installation that made them. Unbound and foreign choices give fresh defaults. Explicit off, an intentionally empty tool checklist and dismissed conversation hints are local to the device. A choice-free device shows saved transcripts as paused. The device policy can reference an immutable root selection and a pending first save. Restore and import keep the destination policy. A move file of this revision is format 3. The snapshot beside this file is the shape of every listed record as the code stands; until a release writes revision 1 it may be edited in place.
formats.olderBuilds: PathKeep 0.4.0 and 0.5.0 cannot parse the stamped archiveMode and stop at start, before any service runs. Before reading the config they act only on records under their own names (.pk-wipe-in-progress.json, archive/.pk-import-journal.json), which revision 1 does not write. They refuse a format-3 move file before asking for its password.
